name: codagent-archon
description: Run the Codagent pack's Archon workflows from your own session: implement an approved OpenSpec change with Archon and follow the run to the end.

interface.shortDescription: Implement an OpenSpec change with Archon
interface.longDescription: Launches the Codagent pack's codagent-implement-change workflow on Archon for an approved OpenSpec change, waits while it runs, brings you its questions, investigates and resumes a failed run, and reports the pull request it opens.
